verses.arabicText: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ حِينٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًۭٔا مَّذْكُورًا
verses.transliteration: Hal atā ʿalā l-insāni ḥīnum-mina d-dahri lam yakun shayam-madhkūrā
verses.translation: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍۢ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Innā khalaqnā l-insāna min-nuṭ'fatin amshājin-nabtalīhi fajaʿalnāhu samīʿan baṣīrā
verses.translation: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًۭا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
verses.transliteration: Innā hadaynāhu s-sabīla immā shākiraw-wa-immā kafūrā
verses.translation: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَٰلًۭا وَسَعِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Innā aʿtadnā lil'kāfirīna salāsilā wa-aghlālaw-wasaʿīrā
verses.translation: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍۢ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
verses.transliteration: Inna l-abrāra yashrabūna min kasin kāna mizājuhā kāfūrā
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kafur,

verses.arabicText: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًۭا
verses.transliteration: ʿaynay-yashrabu bihā ʿibādu l-lahi yufajjirūnahā tafjīrā
verses.translation: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allah will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].

verses.arabicText: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًۭا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًۭا
verses.transliteration: Yūfūna bil-nadhri wayakhāfūna yawman kāna sharruhu mus'taṭīrā
verses.translation: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.

verses.arabicText: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًۭا وَيَتِيمًۭا وَأَسِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Wayuṭ'ʿimūna ṭ-ṭaʿāma ʿalā ḥubbihi mis'kīnaw-wayatīmaw-wa-asīrā
verses.translation: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,

verses.arabicText: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَلَا شُكُورًا
verses.transliteration: Innamā nuṭ'ʿimukum liwajhi l-lahi lā nurīdu minkum jazāaw-walā shukūrā
verses.translation: [Saying], "We feed you only for the countenance of Allah. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًۭا قَمْطَرِيرًۭا
verses.transliteration: Innā nakhāfu mir-rabbinā yawman ʿabūsan qamṭarīrā
verses.translation: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."

verses.arabicText: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةًۭ وَسُرُورًۭا
verses.transliteration: Fawaqāhumu l-lahu sharra dhālika l-yawmi walaqqāhum naḍrataw-wasurūrā
verses.translation: So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness

verses.arabicText: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةًۭ وَحَرِيرًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wajazāhum bimā ṣabarū jannataw-waḥarīrā
verses.translation: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].

verses.arabicText: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًۭا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًۭا
verses.transliteration: Muttakiīna fīhā ʿalā l-arāiki lā yarawna fīhā shamsaw-walā zamharīrā
verses.translation: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.

verses.arabicText: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wadāniyatan ʿalayhim ẓilāluhā wadhullilat quṭūfuhā tadhlīlā
verses.translation: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.

verses.arabicText: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍۢ مِّن فِضَّةٍۢ وَأَكْوَابٍۢ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
verses.transliteration: Wayuṭāfu ʿalayhim biāniyatim-min fiḍḍatiw-wa-akwābin kānat qawārīrā
verses.translation: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],

verses.arabicText: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًۭا
verses.transliteration: Qawārīrā min fiḍḍatin qaddarūhā taqdīrā
verses.translation: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.

verses.arabicText: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Wayus'qawna fīhā kasan kāna mizājuhā zanjabīlā
verses.translation: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger

verses.arabicText: عَيْنًۭا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًۭا
verses.transliteration: ʿaynan fīhā tusammā salsabīlā
verses.translation: [From] a fountain within Paradise named Salsabeel.

verses.arabicText: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌۭ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًۭا مَّنثُورًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wayaṭūfu ʿalayhim wil'dānum-mukhalladūna idhā ra-aytahum ḥasib'tahum lu'lu-am-manthūrā
verses.translation: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.

verses.arabicText: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًۭا وَمُلْكًۭا كَبِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-idhā ra-ayta thamma ra-ayta naʿīmaw-wamul'kan kabīrā
verses.translation: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.

verses.arabicText: عَٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌۭ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌۭ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًۭا طَهُورًا
verses.transliteration: ʿāliyahum thiyābu sundusin khuḍ'ruw-wa-is'tabraquw-waḥullū asāwira min fiḍḍatiw-wasaqāhum rabbuhum sharāban ṭahūrā
verses.translation: Upon the inhabitants will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
verses.transliteration: Inna hādhā kāna lakum jazāaw-wakāna saʿyukum mashkūrā
verses.translation: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًۭا
verses.transliteration: Innā naḥnu nazzalnā ʿalayka l-qur'āna tanzīlā
verses.translation: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Qur'an progressively.

verses.arabicText: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًۭا
verses.transliteration: Fa-iṣ'bir liḥuk'mi rabbika walā tuṭiʿ min'hum āthiman aw kafūrā
verses.translation: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].

verses.arabicText: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةًۭ وَأَصِيلًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa-udh'kuri is'ma rabbika buk'rataw-wa-aṣīlā
verses.translation: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening

verses.arabicText: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًۭا طَوِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Wamina al-layli fa-us'jud lahu wasabbiḥ'hu laylan ṭawīlā
verses.translation: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long [part of the] night.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًۭا ثَقِيلًۭا
verses.transliteration: Inna hāulāi yuḥibbūna l-ʿājilata wayadharūna warāahum yawman thaqīlā
verses.translation: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.

verses.arabicText: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Naḥnu khalaqnāhum washadadnā asrahum wa-idhā shi'nā baddalnā amthālahum tabdīlā
verses.translation: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًۭا
verses.transliteration: Inna hādhihi tadhkiratun faman shāa ittakhadha ilā rabbihi sabīlā
verses.translation: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.

verses.arabicText: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wamā tashāūna illā ay-yashāa l-lahu inna l-laha kāna ʿalīman ḥakīmā
verses.translation: And you do not will except that Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.

verses.arabicText: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
verses.transliteration: Yud'khilu may-yashāu fī raḥmatihi wal-ẓālimīna aʿadda lahum ʿadhāban alīmā
verses.translation: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
